chunks.section: Taxation
chunks.text:
[Scheme: Kotak Gold Fund – Growth Direct]
[Doc: scheme_reference_page | Section: Taxation | Facet: expense_ratio]
As it is a sector - precious metals mutual fund the taxation is as follows:If the fund is equity oriented i.e. asset allocation of more than 65% in equity instruments:For short term (less than a year) capital gains will be taxed at 20%For long term (more than 1 year) capital gains will be taxed at 12.5% without indexation benefitLong term gains up to Rs 1 lakh are exempt from taxation (more than 12 months).

chunks.section: FAQ: What is the current NAV of Kotak Gold Fund?
chunks.text:
[Scheme: Kotak Gold Fund – Growth Direct]
[Doc: scheme_reference_page | Section: FAQ: What is the current NAV of Kotak Gold Fund?]
Q: What is the current NAV of Kotak Gold Fund?
A: The NAV of the fund today is ₹64.64. NAV or Net Asset Value is the per unit price of a mutual fund. For example, if the NAV of a fund is ₹10, it means you can get 1000 units of that mutual fund at ₹10,000.

chunks.text:

[Doc: scheme_reference_page | Section: FAQ: What is the exit load of the fund? | Facet: exit_load]
